meta.name: productivity-clarify
meta.description: Guidelines for clarifying ambiguous tasks. Load when the immediate user request lacks execution context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 澄清模糊任务，明确执行上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常收到模糊不清的任务需求
copy.tagline_en: Clarify ambiguous tasks to define execution context
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often receive vague task requests

howto.what: 当用户请求不明确时，Claude 会先识别缺失的关键信息，然后提出最多三个带选项的简短问题来澄清，之后等待用户回答再继续。
howto.when: 当用户提出的任务缺少执行所需的上下文信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一封邮件，但我不确定收件人和主题。
say.note: Claude 会问收件人是谁、邮件主题等。

say.text: 我想优化这段代码，但不知道目标是什么。
say.note: Claude 会问优化目标（如速度或可读性）。

howto.what_en: When a user request is ambiguous, Claude identifies missing core context, asks up to three concise questions with concrete options, and waits for the user's reply before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's task lacks execution context.

say_en.text: Help me write an email, but I'm not sure about the recipient or subject.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for recipient and subject.

say_en.text: I want to optimize this code, but I don't know the goal.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about optimization target.
